research_role: Development-only independent control screen that defines the complete bad-case set for a later verifier-handoff comparison; it is not an effectiveness estimate.
scientific_question: Among the remaining V2 treatment-unopened development cases, which cases fail under the current scheduled-observation and clean-replay control when judged by EnvBench Official?

selection.rule: Use every row from source positions 9 through 28 in the pre-existing order after positions 1 through 8 were used by the prior incumbent study.

exposure_scope.reason: Several repository identities occurred in earlier EnvSolve, Codex, Repo2Run, or trajectory-analysis studies. This batch can support prospective development decisions for the new handoff but cannot support a fully unseen or held-out claim.

matched_limits.interpretation: These are broad execution safety limits. Token, time, and resource use are outcomes, not success thresholds.

screen_outcome.primary: EnvBench Official Pass or Fail for every scientifically eligible episode
screen_outcome.censoring: Source acquisition, provider outage, researcher interruption, or other infrastructure failure is not an algorithm failure.
screen_outcome.retry: An identity-preserving retry is allowed only when no scientifically valid Agent outcome exists; cases are never replaced after outcomes are observed.

bad_case_derivation.rule: After all 20 screen positions are adjudicated, include every scientifically eligible Official Fail and no Official Pass.
bad_case_derivation.minimum_or_maximum: None. The observed number of eligible failures is the bad-case set size.
bad_case_derivation.zero_failure_decision: If no eligible failure exists, report that this model and control have no measured headroom in this development pool and do not run a success-effect comparison on post-hoc cases.

prospective_pair_stage.timing: The paired schedule is created only after applying the recorded screen rule and before any handoff episode is run.
prospective_pair_stage.episodes: Fresh control and verifier-handoff episodes for every screen failure; screen outcomes are not reused as the paired control outcome.
prospective_pair_stage.matching: Same model, provider policy, initial prompt, tools, base image, source-cache policy, broad limits, and requested seed within each pair.
prospective_pair_stage.ordering: Alternate control-first and treatment-first by bad-case source order.
prospective_pair_stage.primary_metric: Paired EnvBench Official Pass@1 with the exact discordant-pair table.
prospective_pair_stage.resource_metrics: Requests, tokens, wall time, network, storage, and program size are secondary and interpreted only after success.

algorithm_change_policy: Runner 0.6.1 is used unchanged throughout screen and pair stages. No case-specific package rule, checkpoint, cross-case memory, candidate graph, new hard action policy, or prompt change is allowed between stages.
claim_boundary: The screen and paired rerun are development evidence for selecting the fixed EnvSolve-Pro mechanism. Held-out effectiveness, external-baseline superiority, strong-model robustness, and SOTA remain separate future tests.
